h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ulhasnagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ulhasnagar

c: Ulhasnagar is only about 30 km from our factory in Vasai, in the same Thane and Palghar belt that we have supplied for years. The town is tightly built, with small housing societies, trading lanes and very little spare ground. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ulhasnagar for societies, schools, municipal gardens and community halls with an open compound.

In a town this dense, the question is usually how much can fit in a narrow strip of ground. Combination machines help, because they put two or three exercises on a single frame. Our sales team can suggest a compact set from photos of your site, send a layout drawing and install with our own team. The Mumbai region monsoon is heavy, and our galvanised frames and moulded parts are made for it.

richText.heading: A compact open gym for a small society compound

c: A strip along the compound wall can often take two or three frames. The
together cover legs and waist for up to five people at a time.

Keep parking and the gym apart with a low barrier, and leave the clear space marked on our drawing around each frame. If the compound is paved, self-standing frames may work. Otherwise we grout the posts. Raise the base slightly so monsoon water runs off quickly. For a play area in the same compound, see our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 31 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a small society in Ulhasnagar fit an outdoor gym?
items.a: Often, yes. Combination frames put several exercises on one base, so a narrow strip along the compound wall can be enough. Send us the measurements for a layout.

items.q: Since you are close by, can you install quickly?
items.a: Our factory in Vasai is close to Ulhasnagar, so transport is short. Our sales team will confirm the schedule once the layout and quote are approved.

items.q: Can machines be fixed on an existing paved compound?
items.a: Yes. Depending on the paving, we use self-standing frames or grout the posts into a new concrete footing. Photos of the surface help us decide.
